new.s: What does the AP Municipal Laws (Fourth Amendment) Bill, 2026 provide for?

new.x: The AP Municipal Laws (Third Amendment) Bill, 2026 brought a Uniform Mutation Fee; the Fourth Amendment restored direct election of Mayors.

1. It was renamed from Aarogyasri.
2. Amrutha, a scheme under its Trust, is meant for marine fishermen.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Dr NTR Vaidya Seva was renamed from Aarogyasri; Amrutha is for orphans, not marine fishermen.
new.angle: U0812-6 #22 Health scheme -> model and coverage

new.s:
Match the following:
List-I (Scheme)
A. Adarana
B. Amrutha
C. Aarogya Raksha
D. Jeeva Kranthi
List-II (Beneficiaries)
1. APL families
2. Orphans
3. Professional workmen and artisans
4. Women beneficiaries of YSR Cheyutha
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
new.x: Adarana supports artisans, Amrutha covers orphans, Aarogya Raksha is for APL families and Jeeva Kranthi gives livestock units to YSR Cheyutha women.

new.s: On which occasion were the Swachh Andhra Awards 2026 presented at Vijayawada?
new.x: CM Chandrababu Naidu presented the Swachh Andhra Awards 2026 on Swachh Diwas, Gandhi Jayanti, 2 October 2026.
new.angle: U0812 #25 Clean-village campaign -> launch occasion (Swachh Andhra Awards 2026)

new.s: What is the full form of NSAP, whose Central pension share is credited through SNA-SPARSH from 1 October 2026?
new.x: NSAP is the National Social Assistance Programme; its Central share of pensions now goes directly to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.

new.s: Pulicat Lake, where a GPS-based fishing boundary is planned, is shared by which two States?
new.x: Pulicat is a brackish-water lake shared by Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.

new.s: Who chairs the State Apprenticeship Council of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Principal Secretary, Skill Development & Training Department
new.x: The State Apprenticeship Council is chaired by the Principal Secretary, Skill Development & Training; the Director of Employment and Training chairs the NAPS 2.0 committee.

new.s: Under which Act was the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) set up?
new.x: FSSAI was set up under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006; it is under the Union Health Ministry, with HQ at New Delhi.

new.s: With which organisation is Andhra Pradesh setting up a permanent Pan-IIT Council at Amaravati?
o: All India Council for Technical Education
new.x: The AP Government and PanIIT Alumni India agreed on a permanent Pan-IIT Council at Amaravati.

new.s: What is the full form of APCNF, which won the 2026 Food Planet Prize?
o: Andhra Pradesh Community Managed Natural Farming
Andhra Pradesh Community Network for Farmers
new.x: APCNF stands for Andhra Pradesh Community Managed Natural Farming, implemented by Rythu Sadhikara Samstha.

new.s: Where was Netanna Sevalo launched on the 12th National Handloom Day, 7 August 2026?
new.x: CM Naidu launched Netanna Sevalo at Kothapeta, Vetapalem mandal, in Chirala constituency of Bapatla district.

new.s: Which department implements Talliki Vandanam in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Talliki Vandanam, formerly Amma Vodi, is run by the School Education Department and pays ₹15,000 per child.

new.s: What is the purpose of the e-Suvidha project in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Monitoring of urban water supply works
new.x: e-Suvidha computerises Urban Local Bodies (online payments, certificates, municipal services); OWMS monitors works and Mee Mart modernises ration shops.
new.angle: U0812 PYQ yd638f2d30ff app -> purpose (e-Suvidha, other direction)

new.s: In which district did Operation Chaitanyam destroy ganja on 94.77 acres using drones and satellite imagery?
new.x: Operation Chaitanyam was carried out in Alluri Sitarama Raju (ASR) district.

new.s: Who founded Bedford School (1552), which is setting up the first foreign educational institution in Amaravati?
new.x: Bedford School was founded in 1552 by King Edward VI.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Annadata Sukhibhava–PM Kisan:
1. The annual support is ₹20,000 per farmer.
2. It is paid in two instalments.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The support is ₹20,000 a year (₹14,000 State + ₹6,000 Centre), paid in three instalments, not two.

new.s: Which Prime Minister introduced the Twenty Point Programme in 1975?
new.x: The Twenty Point Programme was introduced by Indira Gandhi in 1975; in AP its implementation committee is chaired by Lanka Dinakar.
new.angle: U0812 PYQ y1eeea31065e Twenty Point Programme -> introducer

new.s: Which case held that the right to livelihood is a part of Article 21?
new.x: Olga Tellis (1985) held that the right to livelihood is part of the right to life under Article 21.

new.s: Which component of Andhra Pradesh's draft Population Management Policy 2026 deals with maternal health?
new.x: Matrutva covers maternal health; Kshema is elderly care, Shakti is women's workforce and Naipunyam is skills.

new.s: Where is the headquarters of the National Biodiversity Authority?
new.x: The NBA, set up in 2003 under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002, has its headquarters at Chennai.

new.s: In which districts was the Hello Kidney project for early detection of kidney disease piloted?
new.x: Hello Kidney, an AI-based early detection project, was piloted in NTR and Anantapur districts.
new.angle: U0812 #22 Health initiative -> pilot districts (Hello Kidney)

new.s: What was Jagananna Animutyalu, the scheme of awards to toppers, renamed as?
new.x: Jagananna Animutyalu became the Abdul Kalam Pratibha Puraskaram.

new.s:
Match the following:
List-I (Cluster)
A. Quantum Valley
B. Electronics–Aero City
C. Electronics–Space City
D. Drone City
List-II (Place)
1. Orvakal
2. Tirupati
3. Lepakshi
4. Amaravati
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
new.x: Quantum Valley is at Amaravati, Electronics–Aero City at Lepakshi, Electronics–Space City at Tirupati and Drone City at Orvakal.

new.s: Under Swarnandhra Vision-2047, to what level is Andhra Pradesh's unemployment rate to be reduced from 4.1%?
new.x: Vision-2047 targets cutting unemployment from 4.1% to 2%.

new.s: Where is the headquarters of APSRTC, established in 1958?
new.x: APSRTC was established in 1958 and has its headquarters at Vijayawada.

new.s: Which was India's first police-specific AI hackathon?
new.x: The AI4 Andhra Police Hackathon (June 2025) was India's first police-specific AI hackathon and led to the AI4AP project.

new.s: Who launched the AI4AP Police project at the Mangalagiri Police Headquarters?
new.x: DGP Harish Kumar Gupta launched AI4AP at Mangalagiri Police HQ; it was piloted in Chittoor, Guntur and Annamayya.

new.s: Under which Article of the Constitution is the Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission a constitutional body?
new.x: Public Service Commissions are set up under Article 315; APPSC's Chairman and Members are appointed by the Governor.

new.s: Which agency implements the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)?
new.x: PMEGP, a Central Sector Scheme of 2008, is implemented by KVIC, a statutory body under the KVIC Act, 1956.

new.s: To which district does the new Addanki revenue division belong?
new.x: The Addanki division (Addanki, Darsi) was formed in Prakasam district.

new.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's modified livestock insurance scheme, in what ratio do the Centre and the State share the remaining 85% of the premium?
new.x: The farmer pays 15%; the rest is shared 60:40 by the Centre and AP, which is a general-category State.
new.angle: U0812 #3 Scheme model -> cost sharing (livestock insurance)

new.s: What is the capital expenditure in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27?
new.x: Capital expenditure is about ₹53,915 crore; ₹75,868 crore is the fiscal deficit and ₹22,003 crore the revenue deficit.

new.s: What is Andhra Pradesh's own tax revenue in BE 2026-27?
new.x: Own tax revenue is ₹1,25,845.78 crore; ₹64,362.16 crore is the share in central taxes.

new.s: What was Andhra Pradesh's rank among States in merchandise exports in 2025-26 as per DGFT data?
new.x: AP ranked 7th with ₹1.77 lakh crore; Telangana was 8th and Gujarat 1st.
new.angle: U0813-1 #6 Ranking -> AP rank in exports

new.s: According to the Second Census of Water Bodies, what share of Andhra Pradesh's water bodies is in rural areas?
new.x: 99.68% of AP's water bodies are rural; 60.33% are tanks and 49.48% are privately owned.

new.s: What is the full form of SASCI, under which Andhra Pradesh gets ₹8,226 crore in 2026-27?
o: State Assistance Scheme for Capital Infrastructure
Special Allocation to States for Capital Improvement
Special Assistance to States for Capital Investment
Scheme of Assistance to States for Capital Infrastructure
new.x: SASCI is Special Assistance to States for Capital Investment: 50-year interest-free loans under the Ministry of Finance.

new.s: In Q2 of 2025-26, Andhra Pradesh's GSDP grew by 11.28%. What was the all-India GDP growth in that quarter?
new.x: AP's Q2 2025-26 growth of 11.28% was well above the all-India GDP growth of 8.7%.

new.s: What was the revised estimate of Andhra Pradesh's fiscal deficit for 2025-26, as a share of GSDP?
new.x: The 2025-26 fiscal deficit was budgeted at 4.4% and revised to 4.6% of GSDP; 3.8% is the 2026-27 target.

new.s: Who is the Chairman of the 16th Finance Commission?
new.x: The 16th Finance Commission is chaired by Dr. Arvind Panagariya; the Finance Commission is set up under Article 280.
new.angle: U0813-2 #8 Central transfers -> 16th Finance Commission chair

new.s: For which two cities was ₹2,085 crore earlier sanctioned to Andhra Pradesh under the Urban Challenge Fund?
new.x: ₹2,085 crore was earlier given for Visakhapatnam and Mangalagiri-Tadepalli; the 2nd tranche proposal is ₹5,940 crore.
new.angle: U0813-2 #16 Central funds -> Urban Challenge Fund

new.s: How many DWCRA women received individual business loans, placing Andhra Pradesh first in promoting women entrepreneurs in 2025-26?
new.x: AP gave loans to 1.47 lakh DWCRA women (99% of target); Telangana (1.28 lakh) and UP (1.09 lakh) followed.

new.s: What is the full form of VB-GRAM, implemented in Andhra Pradesh from 1 July 2026?
o: Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Aajeevika Mission (Grameen)
Viksit Bharat – Gramin Rozgar and Aajeevika Mission
Village Bharat – Guarantee for Rural Asset Management
Viksit Bharat – Grameen Rural Area Mission
new.x: VB-GRAM is the Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Aajeevika Mission (Grameen), funded 60:40 by the Centre and State.

new.s: What is Andhra Pradesh's share in central taxes (devolution) in BE 2026-27?
new.x: AP's share in central taxes is ₹64,362.16 crore; its own tax revenue is ₹1,25,845.78 crore.

new.s: How much was allocated for ports in Andhra Pradesh's 2026-27 capital allocations?
new.x: Ports got ₹5,437 crore; roads ₹3,439 crore, airports ₹2,302 crore and Polavaram ₹8,300 crore.

new.s: Which district had the lowest urbanisation (2.84%) among Andhra Pradesh's district indicators cited?
new.x: Polavaram had the lowest urbanisation (2.84%) and density; Visakhapatnam had the highest (89.69%).

new.s: What is the outlay of Andhra Pradesh's proposed Mushroom Mission?
new.x: The Mushroom Mission has an outlay of ₹13,000 crore, with about ₹5,184 crore (~40%) as subsidy.

new.s: What was Andhra Pradesh's Rabi paddy procurement target for 2026?
new.x: The Rabi 2026 target was 23 lakh MT through 1,917 centres; about 51 lakh MT was procured in the previous Kharif.

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution directs the State to promote cottage industries?
new.x: Article 43 (a Directive Principle) asks the State to promote cottage industries, such as handlooms.

new.s: How much nitrogen does urea contain?
new.x: Urea contains 46% nitrogen, but crops absorb only 30-40% of it.

new.s: How much area did Andhra Pradesh cover under micro irrigation in 2025-26, ranking first in India?
new.x: AP covered 3.15 lakh ha for 1,08,143 farmers; Gujarat (2.63), Tamil Nadu (2.62) and Rajasthan (2.42 lakh ha) followed.

new.s: Which commission is associated with BC reservation in local bodies in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The Rajeev Ranjan Mishra Commission is linked with BC reservation in AP local bodies.
new.angle: U0813-4 notes gap Commission -> subject (BC quota)

new.s: What is Operation TRACE of the Andhra Pradesh Police meant for?
new.x: Operation TRACE traced 1,177 girls and 2,483 women in four months.

new.s: How many districts does the Visakha Economic Region announced in the AP Budget 2026–27 cover?
new.x: The Visakha Economic Region covers 10 districts (₹28,000 crore); the Amaravati Economic Region covers 9.
new.angle: U0813-4 #16 New announcement -> Visakha Economic Region

new.s: Which district ranked second in GDDP in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26 (advance estimates)?
new.x: Visakhapatnam was first and NTR second in GDDP; in per capita income, Krishna was second.

new.s: What is the objective of the AP Rural Inclusive Growth Project (APRIGP)?
o: Raising farm incomes of poor households and their access to health, nutrition and entitlements
new.x: APRIGP, funded by the World Bank (IDA) and run by SERP, aims to raise farm incomes of poor households in 150 backward mandals.
